title: An ASCII table
description:
Print the printable ASCII characters with their codes.

```
 32 ' '   33 '!'   34 '"'   35 '#'   36 '$'   37 '%'
 38 '&'   39 "'"   ...
```
hints: `end=""` in `print` keeps several entries on one line; print a new line after every sixth (lesson 3.01).
`f"{code:3} {chr(code)!r:5}"` prints the code and the character in quotes.
requirements: Codes 32 to 126, six per line, using `chr`.
Also print the codes of a word the user types with `ord`.
stretch: Show that upper and lower case letters differ by exactly one bit (32).
